sections.title: Attendance
sections.text: A student must have at least 75 percent attendance in each subject to appear in the end-semester examination. A student with attendance between 65 and 75 percent may apply for condonation on medical grounds and must pay a condonation fee of Rs. 500 per subject. A student with attendance below 65 percent is detained and must repeat the semester.

sections.title: Assessment
sections.text: Every subject has 40 marks of internal assessment and 60 marks of end-semester examination. To pass a subject a student must score at least 40 percent in the end-semester examination and at least 50 percent in total. SAMPLE DATA for testing - not real course material | page 1

sections.title: Grading
sections.text: Marks are converted to letter grades: O for 90 and above, A+ for 80 to 89, A for 70 to 79, B+ for 60 to 69, B for 50 to 59 and F below 50. The CGPA is the sum of credits times grade points divided by the sum of credits.

sections.title: Re-evaluation
sections.text: A student may apply for re-evaluation within 7 days of the result being published, with a fee of Rs. 1000 per paper. The better of the two scores is kept.

sections.title: Backlogs
sections.text: A student who fails a subject may appear in the supplementary examination. The maximum duration to complete the 8-semester programme is 6 years. SAMPLE DATA for testing - not real course material | page 2
